2123101308269813853.en_summary: People love to say bulls are greedy but if you lived through the 2022 bear market you know that bears are in fact the greediest of them all. $NVDA lost nearly 70% of its value in 10 months and people still said it was overvalued. They shorted the entirety of 2023 while claiming the new uptrend was simply a bear market rally. By the time the market broke out into new all-time highs in 2024, they switched their stance.
2123101308269813853.zh_summary: 人們喜歡說多頭貪婪，但如果你經歷過 2022 年熊市，你知道空頭才是最貪婪的。$NVDA 在 10 個月內損失了近 70% 的價值，人們仍說它估值過高。他們在整個 2023 年做空，同時聲稱新上漲趨勢只是熊市反彈。等到 2024 年市場突破新高時，他們才改變立場。
